# feriados.dev open source

feriados.dev open source is a self-hosted, Brazil-only REST API for national,
state and municipal holidays.

## Key Files

- [README](README.md): quickstart, endpoints and project overview.
- [Agent Instructions](AGENTS.md): rules for AI coding agents.
- [API Context for AI](docs/API_CONTEXT_FOR_AI.md): domain model, hierarchy,
  response patterns and pitfalls.
- [AI Playbook](docs/AI_PLAYBOOK.md): repeatable AI-assisted workflows.
- [AI SDLC](docs/AI_SDLC.md): development lifecycle for AI-assisted changes.
- [OpenAPI](docs/openapi/feriados-v1.openapi.yaml): public API contract.
- [Prompts](prompts/): reusable prompts for data corrections, PR review, bug
  investigation and release checks.

## Boundaries

The OSS version has no auth, billing, plans, quotas, API keys, checkout or
Stripe. Keep it self-hosted and public by default.

## Validation

Run:

```bash
npm run lint
npm run build
npm test
npm run migrate -- --dry-run
npm run smoke
```
